title: Wait for the northern lights near Fairbanks
description: Leave Fairbanks behind for a darker sky and give the night time to unfold. You might watch from a heated lodge between trips outside, scanning the stars until a pale arc becomes moving curtains of green. The waiting, warm drinks, and sudden rush back into the cold are part of the memory, even though the aurora never keeps an appointment.
teaser: Settle in for a dark Alaskan night and watch the sky.
goodToKnow: Aurora season extends through April. Weather and sightings are never guaranteed.
whyItMightDelightYou: This is a rare adventure that rewards patience: the best moment can arrive when everyone has almost stopped looking.
